# Vendored: gce-tcb-verifier

`endorsement.proto` is copied unmodified from
[google/gce-tcb-verifier](https://github.com/google/gce-tcb-verifier) at commit
`e3ac0cb1bf1072be139a2971534757e2ade492a5` (`proto/endorsement.proto`), Apache-2.0.
It describes Google's signed UEFI launch endorsements, which the verifier's check 5
parses (SPEC.md decision 5). Update it only together with the verifier.
